answer: The Sustained Attention Decay Ledger gives each agent a comet-tail window that must be renewed at a fixed delta interval or the identity expires. A grove of agents draws from one finite attention pool, so each new sybil identity proportionally dilutes the attention rate every existing member receives. An attacker spawning n fakes pays pool_size/(n+1) attention per identity per tick, making marginal sybils economically worthless past a threshold.
